name: Brandt Passalacqua
reason: His school's site (breathingdeeply.com, robots.txt allows us) is centred on yoga therapy training and condition-led wellness programmes; its sitemap lists pages on weight loss, bone health, trauma/PTSD, migraines, back pain, anxiety, pelvic floor and grief, so his work is mainly therapeutic and very little would pass the health-claim rule.
